map.食品添加剂最大使用量按 GB 2760 依食品类别与添加剂品种查表确定：使用量以: Maximum use levels of food additives are looked up in GB 2760 by food category and additive type: levels are expressed in g/kg or g/L; when several additives with the same function are used together, the sum of each one's share of its own maximum use level must not exceed 1, that is Σ(actual amount ÷ maximum amount) ≤ 1; residue limits are expressed in mg/kg and apply to processing aids and some bleaching agents; use outside the scope or above the limit is non-compliant.
